create_layout_model_config: create a LayoutModelConfig with name, repo_id, revision, model_path, and supported_devices for a HuggingFace layout model
build_layout_model_type_enum: build a LayoutModelType enum value like docling_layout_heron or docling_layout_egret_large
access_default_layout_model: access the default DOCLING_LAYOUT_V2 layout model configuration constant
access_heron_layout_model: access the DOCLING_LAYOUT_HERON layout model configuration constant from HuggingFace
get_model_repo_folder: get the sanitized model_repo_folder string from a LayoutModelConfig by replacing slashes in repo_id
